description.zh-CN: 浏览模组、安装依赖、检查更新，以及打开模组的独立发布页。联网安装需确认风险，默认不执行下载的代码；更新前保留旧包恢复备份。
description.en-US: Browse mods, install dependencies, check updates and view release pages. Online installation requires consent and leaves downloaded code disabled by default; updates keep recovery copies of previous packages.
